newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Autoliv says Fred Musone leaves group.
newsitem.headline: Autoliv says Fred Musone leaves group.

text.p: Swedish/U.S. car safety equipment group Autoliv Inc said on Wednesday that Fred Musone, the head of Autoliv ASP Inc in the U.S. and chief operating officer in the Autoliv Inc group, had left the group.
Robert Rapone, head of production in Autoliv Inc and Autoliv ASP Inc, left on June 11 along with Musone, the company said in a statement.
While waiting for replacements, Autoliv ASP will be run by a group led by ASP's technical director Tom Hartman.
The company did not give any reasons for the sudden resignations. The company's share price dropped 3.5 crowns to 306.5 on Wednesday.
